title: Bhop universal script
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local bhopEnabled = true
local boostPower = 0.5 

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not bhopEnabled then return end
    
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local rootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    if humanoid and rootPart and UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
        if humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
            humanoid.Jump = true
        else
            local moveDir = humanoid.MoveDirection
            if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
                rootPart.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame + (moveDir * boostPower)
            end
        end
    end
end)
